# zenthcloud_workers_cron_trigger (Resource)

Accepted Permissions

- `Workers Scripts Read`
- `Workers Scripts Write`

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "zenthcloud_workers_cron_trigger" "example_workers_cron_trigger" {
  account_id = "023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353"
  script_name = "this-is_my_script-01"
  schedules = [{
    cron = "*/30 * * * *"
  }]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) Identifier.
- `schedules` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedules))
- `script_name` (String) Name of the script.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Name of the script.

<a id="nestedatt--schedules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schedules`

Required:

Read-Only:

- `modified_on` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
$ terraform import zenthcloud_workers_cron_trigger.example '<account_id>/<script_name>'
```
